text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: y binge-watches x.
Download(x, y) ::: y downloads x.
Share(x, y) ::: y shares x to Lisa.
NetflixShow(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
Karen(y) ::: y is Karen.
Question: ::: "Black Mirror" is popular.

Premises:
If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it. ::: ∀x (NetflixShow(x) ∧ Popular(x) → BingeWatch(x, Karen))
If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will download it. ::: ∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen) → Download(x, Karen))
Karen does not download "Black Mirror". ::: ¬Download("Black Mirror", Karen)
"Black Mirror" is a Netflix show. ::: NetflixShow("Black Mirror")
If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will share it to Lisa. ::: ∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen) → Share(x, Lisa))

Conclusion:
Question: ::: "Black Mirror" is popular.
